notes.title: Develop Plan
notes.content:
Hello everyone, since the release of Idle Tower Defense, we have received a lot of encouragement, suggestions and criticism. Thank you all very much for playing.
I know Idle Tower Defense was not released as early access, but we will continue to update it with more content.
Thank you all for your support and understanding.

Here's our current development plan:
1. a new talent system.
2. more linkage between effects
3. some new modules
4. some new ascension effects
5. adjustments to existing modules and effects

notes.title: [v1.0.8] Update About Ascension
notes.content:
Modules can now be permanently unlocked and upgraded at Ascension, and all skill points can be retained.
Also the [Damage Diamond] effect becomes a damage bonus, with all damage bonuses calculated in a separate multiplier zone.
The damage formula: Attack x (1 + Attack Bonus) x (1 + Damage Bonus)
